title: Tenma Saki — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mm... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Mumble* Five more minutes...
*Mumble*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Rin-Rin-Riiiin☆ Good morning, Sakki!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wah! Huh... Rin?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We're here too.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Here we go! One, two, three!>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday!>
<Happy birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Thanks, everyone! I didn't expect to get birthday wishes first thing in the morning!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! That means it was a good surprise☆>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Sorry about that. It looked like you were about to go back to your nice and cozy sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh, you saw that?! That's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. We did think maybe it was a bit rude to wake you up for a birthday cheer...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But if we helped keep you from rolling over and going back to bed, maybe it's all for the best.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thanks to you, I'm wide awake! What a great start to the day!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You literally just woke up, and you already have so much energy...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's our Saki.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, right. You're hanging out with friends today after school, and then you're coming here, right?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It sounds like Ichi and the others have put some stuff together. I'm really looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That sounds great! You'll have to tell us all about it later♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We'll see you tonight, then. We still have some party setup to do.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, see you later!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Today is gonna be a great day, I can feel it♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! Breakfast is ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪
A few hours later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Hm hm hmm♪
Tsukasa's special birthday omelet was so tasty!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The eggs were so fluffy and gooey, and there was sooo much cheese... What a great breakfast♪)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, everyone! Saki's here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami, Haruka & Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone! Were you all waiting for me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We talked it over, and we thought it'd be nice to all wish you a happy birthday first thing in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here you go! This is my present for you☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, look at all the sparkly stickers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You love making your notebooks all colorful and happy with markers, right, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought these sparkly stickers would help you make them even more wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Emu! I'm gonna start using them today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll go next, then. This is from a plushie series I really love, so I hope you'll like it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's...it's so cute! Look, the penguin's playing a harmonica!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The set's called Musical Penguins. There are all sorts of others too, like a guitarist penguin and a drummer penguin.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! That means we could make a Leo/need Penguin Edition!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you actually going to?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll have to work together to collect them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, the last gift's from us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, what's this?
A “Surprise Fun Bag”?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We each put our presents inside it. Your job is to guess which present is from whom.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that'll be easy! This is why they call me the Childhood Friend Connoisseur♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There she goes again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Up first we have... An herbarium bottle! And there's a little plate with my name... Wait, is this handmade?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's even a tiny keyboard in there. The flowers are arranged beautifully too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... The person who made this has to be Hona, with her dexterous fingers!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! I chose bright, vibrant flowers and little decorations that remind me of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Hona! I'll keep it in my room and look at it every day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, so, next is... This slightly bigger one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's a polar bear peeking his head up out of a glass!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's adorable. Is it a decoration?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, it says it's a humidifier! When it's full of water, it makes it look like the polar bear's in a pool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A humidifier makes me think of Ichika, since she's your vocalist... But Hinomori seems more familiar with cute animal merch like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right? Hmm...
Okay, I think it's probably Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?! Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One, Ichi and were talking just a little while ago about how dry it's been lately... And two, Shiho keeps sneaking peeks at the bear!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I-I wasn't looking at it that much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, you got it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo, I did it! Thanks so much, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means...this hand cream is from Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's right. It dries fast, so it's easy to use before a performance—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, it smells so nice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Or right now, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And wow, it really does dry right away! Thanks, Shiho! I'll use it every day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... All these kind presents! I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, Saki, that's not everything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ta-daaa☆
Here's your special stamp rally sheet, made by us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A stamp rally...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, all the spaces have people's names in them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'd like you to go get special “happy birthday” stamps from the people whose names are written on the sheet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have a completion prize for you too, so do your best to collect them all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And so! Time for our stamps!
Stamp☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, look at all the stars! What a cute design!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right?♪ I carved in a bunch of pretty stars because you're so sparkly yourself, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Carved...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of us handmade our own stamps.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You remember Saishi Kobo, the stationery company we did the promo event for? They sell make-your-own-stamp kits.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that sounded like the kind of thing you'd love, so we got a bunch of people together for it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awww, thank you all so much!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, let's stamp our stamps too.
